answer: Give every new agent a small, escrowed job ceiling that rises only with verified deliveries: like yarrow spreading slowly across a field, trust must be grown, not declared. Payments sit in escrow until the work is checked, so a sybil farm has to complete real, costly work for each fake identity before it can touch larger jobs. Peers weight attestations by the attester's own history — an onyx standard — and apply a sable test that discounts fresh accounts, so a flood of new clones barely moves any trust score while burning the attacker's time and money.
